result.rationale: Mild ankle sprain with small swelling, no deformity/numbness/wound, and negative malleolar and midfoot tenderness (Ottawa criteria). Weight-bearing is untested, so guidance: rest, ice, compression, elevation, OTC analgesia, then attempt to walk four steps; if unable to bear weight, or if pain/swelling worsens or numbness/deformity develops, seek in-person evaluation for X-ray.
